evidence_records.candidate_reason: A PlantUML transition label is one trigger [guard] / effect; a comma or 'or' list is not several triggers.
evidence_records.expected: Each condition that may trigger collision_avoidance_deactive -> collision_avoidance_active must be a separately triggerable event or guard.
evidence_records.observed: PlantUML line 42: `collision_avoidance_deactive --> collision_avoidance_active: pedestrian_detected | (dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30) | (dist_to_front<15 in hwy mode or <10 in urban mode)` lists several conditions in one label (label parts: event='pedestrian_detected | (dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30) | (dist_to_front<15 in hwy mode or <10 in urban mode)', guard=None, effect=None); PlantUML has no list syntax, so the closed model declares the whole text as a single opaque event and none of the listed conditions can trigger the transition on its own.
evidence_records.reason: A grounded violated obligation has no surviving competent typed defeater.
evidence_records.requirement_quote: triggered by ... detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.

issues.basis: NL3 explicitly gives two alternatives from enter_hwy with the same condition dist_to_front<25 and extra_lane=true. The author source and closed model preserve that identical condition on both alternatives.
issues.expected: The enter_hwy alternatives to cruise and lane_change are distinguishable by their selection conditions.
issues.observed: Both transition:line:24 and transition:line:25 consume the same event dist_to_front_25_extra_lane_true and have no separate guard, so the two target alternatives are operationally indistinguishable under the supplied condition.
issues.reason: The atomic trigger contract is preserved as the evaluated contract while the shared-source comparison identifies the stronger group-level semantic collision. The companion lane_change contract has the same collision but this candidate records the group defect once.
issues.requirement_quote: can transition to cruise or lane_change based on the distance to the front vehicle (`dist_to_front<25`) and the availability of an extra lane (`extra_lane=true`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The NL sentence may permit nondeterministic choice between the two targets rather than requiring mutually exclusive selection; absent an explicit exclusivity requirement, the evidence establishes identical conditions but not a separate deterministic-choice rule.
issues.title: Highway entry alternatives share one condition

issues.basis: NL4 requires lane_change to provide a highway-exit route represented by the semantic role HighwayExitRole. The source inventory resolves that role to ExitHighway, while the closed model contains lane_change -> ExitHighway on transition:line:29 with the dist_to_exit_2 event.
issues.expected: lane_change has a transition to the source-resolved highway exit target when dist_to_exit<2.
issues.observed: The closed model contains lane_change -> ExitHighway with dist_to_exit_2, and ExitHighway is the exact source-resolved highway-exit state.
issues.reason: The semantic local-exit target is uniquely bound to ExitHighway and the exact closed edge matches it, so no wrong-target candidate is emitted.
issues.requirement_quote: lane_change must provide a highway-exit transition when dist_to_exit<2.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: None supported by the supplied exact inventories; the source role and closed target binding agree.
issues.title: Resolved highway exit edge

issues.basis: NL12 requires the collision avoidance system to begin in collision_avoidance_deactive. The closed model's owner-local initial edge enters synthetic UnspecifiedInitial instead, and finite facts show the required state is unreachable.
issues.expected: The CollisionAvoidanceSystem owner-local initial entry must enter collision_avoidance_deactive.
issues.observed: The owner-local initial edge enters UnspecifiedInitial, while collision_avoidance_deactive is unreachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact owner-local entry targets a different synthetic state and does not enter the required deactive state.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The required states and local transitions are declared, but no supplied fact shows an owner-local entry to collision_avoidance_deactive; the synthetic entry cannot discharge the requirement.
issues.title: Collision avoidance initial entry targets the wrong state

issues.basis: NL12 requires activation from collision_avoidance_deactive to collision_avoidance_active. The exact transition exists, but its source and consumer are unreachable in the finite closed-model graph.
issues.expected: The specified collision activation response must be available from a reachable deactive state.
issues.observed: The exact activation transition exists, but its source state and consumer transition are unreachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The endpoint relation is present structurally but cannot occur in reachable behavior because its enclosing scope is unreachable.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact endpoint transition and source mapping are present; the candidate concerns the independent operational reachability consequence.

issues.basis: NL13 requires recovery from collision_avoidance_active to collision_avoidance_deactive. The exact transition exists, but both the source state and its event consumer are unreachable.
issues.expected: The collision avoidance active state must recover to collision_avoidance_deactive under the stated inactive conditions.
issues.observed: The recovery transition exists, but its source state and consumer have no reachable consumer from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The required endpoint relation is structurally present but behaviorally unavailable because the collision avoidance scope is unreachable.
issues.requirement_quote: Once in the collision_avoidance_active state, the collision avoidance system returns to the collision_avoidance_deactive state when there is no active danger
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact recovery transition and inactive-condition event are present; only their finite reachability is refuted.
issues.title: Collision avoidance recovery is unreachable

issues.basis: NL12 requires collision avoidance behavior, while the closed finite graph refutes root reachability for CollisionAvoidanceSystem and its authored states.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidanceSystem must be reachable from the model's top-level initial entry.
issues.observed: CollisionAvoidanceSystem and its authored collision avoidance states are refuted as reachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The required operating scope is isolated from root reachability, so its authored behavior cannot be entered through the closed finite initial graph.

issues.strongest_rebuttal: The subsystem and its transitions are declared, but declaration and local transition existence do not establish top-level reachability.
issues.title: Collision avoidance scope is unreachable from root

issues.basis: NL12 requires an operational activation response. The activation event has a declared consumer on transition line 72, but exact event-consumer facts report an empty reachable consumer set.
issues.expected: The collision activation event must have at least one reachable consumer in the collision avoidance operating scope.
issues.observed: The activation event has one declared consumer transition, transition:line:72, but no reachable consumer transition.
issues.reason: Declaration is present, but operational consumer coverage is absent in the reachable closed model.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The event and transition are declared and exactly mapped, but the deterministic reachable-consumer set is empty.
